newsitem.title: USA: $1.6 trillion emerging debt traded in Q1 - survey.
newsitem.headline: $1.6 trillion emerging debt traded in Q1 - survey.

text.p: Trading volume in emerging markets debt instruments totaled $1.6 trillion in the first quarter of 1997, according to the Emerging Markets Traders Association's (EMTA) debut quarterly volume survey.
Last year, $5.3 trillion of emerging markets debt traded, EMTA said. The association did not have comparative figures for first-quarter 1996.
Brady bonds comprised the largest portion of trading volume, accounting for $671 billion of first-quarter transactions, or 41.4 percent.
